parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this value is available, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description:
The ID of the update batch.

This is the **JobId** returned after you call [CreateOTAVerifyJob](~~147480~~), [CreateOTAStaticUpgradeJob](~~147496~~), or [CreateOTADynamicUpgradeJob](~~147887~~) to create an update batch. You can also view this value on the **Update Package Details** page in the IoT Platform console.
